Specify which address acquisition method to use:
DHCP with fallback - the switch sends DHCP requests every second and, while no DHCP server is answering, immediately uses the configured Static IP Address value. When a server answers, the switch obtains a lease in 1-2 seconds and renews it at half the lease time. If a renewal goes unanswered, the switch returns to the Static IP Address value in 5 seconds and resumes sending requests every second.
static - address is set as a Static IP Address value (IPv4 only)
DHCP only - switch uses DHCPv4 client to acquire address
